# VIZIT AI — Universal Business Entity Pages

VIZIT AI provides automatically generated, SEO-optimized entity pages for every business in our database.

## Endpoint Structure

Each business has a dedicated page at:
```
/place/{slug}
```

Example:
- `/place/drinkit` — Drinkit bar page
- `/place/business-name` — Any other business

## Page Content

Each entity page includes the following sections (when data is available):

1. **Hero Section** — Business name, category, location, CTA buttons
2. **About** — Description and summary
3. **USP (Unique Selling Proposition)** — Key advantages
4. **Offerings** — Services and products
5. **Audience** — Target customer profile
6. **Practical Info** — Hours, payment methods, contact details
7. **Directions** — Address, landmarks, how to get there
8. **Nearby & Related** — Nearby landmarks and related businesses
9. **FAQ** — Frequently asked questions with answers
10. **Tips** — Visitor tips and local guide recommendations
11. **Additional Info** — AI context, semantic relations

## Data Source

All content is fetched from the backend API:
```
GET https://vizit-backend-vdt2.onrender.com/api/v1/places/{slug}
```

The frontend dynamically renders all available fields — no hardcoded business names or manual updates required.

## Structured Data (JSON-LD)

Each page includes:
- `LocalBusiness` schema (or subtype based on category)
- `FAQPage` schema (if FAQ exists)

Fields include: name, description, address, geo coordinates, phone, website, opening hours, price range, features.

## SEO Features

- Dynamic `<title>` and meta description per page
- OpenGraph tags for social sharing
- Twitter Card metadata
- Canonical URL
- Crawler-friendly HTML rendering

## Sitemap

Dynamic sitemap is generated by the backend at:
```
https://vizit-backend-vdt2.onrender.com/sitemap.xml
```

## Analytics

Page views are tracked via Google Analytics (gtag) when available:
- Event: `page_view`
- Label: business slug

## Adding New Businesses

No frontend changes required. When a new business is added to the backend:
1. Backend generates the full entity data
2. Frontend automatically renders it at `/place/{slug}`
3. Sitemap is updated by backend
4. JSON-LD and SEO metadata are auto-generated

## Contact

For questions about entity pages or data accuracy, contact the VIZIT AI team.
